FINDING: Hardcoded administrator password (`supersecret123`) exposes privileged credentials to anyone with source access (`auth.py:4`).

FINDING: Passwords are hashed with MD5, an obsolete, fast, unsalted algorithm vulnerable to brute-force and rainbow-table attacks (`auth.py:7-8`).

FINDING: `get_user_profile` directly interpolates `username` into SQL, enabling SQL injection when the returned query is executed (`auth.py:11-12`).
